title: Chick waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="28" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Body shading -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="22" ry="22" fill="#FFC300"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="20" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="34" r="14" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <!-- Left wing (down) -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="66" rx="8" ry="13" transform="rotate(15 24 66)" fill="#FFC300"/>
  <!-- Right wing (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="42" rx="8" ry="14" transform="rotate(-35 80 42)" fill="#FFC300"/>
  <!-- Wing tip -->
  <ellipse cx="85" cy="32" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="36" r="3.5" fill="#5B2E00"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="36" r="3.5" fill="#5B2E00"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="35" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="35" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points="48,43 52,43 50,48" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <!-- Beak highlight -->
  <polygon points="49,43.5 51,43.5 50,46" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="43" r="3" fill="#FF9A9E" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="43" r="3" fill="#FF9A9E" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <!-- Feet toes -->
  <line x1="38" y1="90" x2="37" y2="94" stroke="#E07000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="91" x2="42" y2="95" stroke="#E07000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="90" x2="47" y2="94" stroke="#E07000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="90" x2="53" y2="94" stroke="#E07000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="91" x2="58" y2="95" stroke="#E07000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="90" x2="63" y2="94" stroke="#E07000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Little head tuft -->
  <path d="M48,18 Q50,12 52,18" fill="#FFC300" stroke="none"/>
  <path d="M52,19 Q55,14 56,20" fill="#FFC300" stroke="none"/>
</svg>
